title: LensDB lens record
description: One optical design (a lens) in the LensDB comparison database. One row per optical design, not per mount: a lens sold in several mounts lists them all in `mounts`. Numeric fields use null when a value cannot be reliably sourced, never a guessed number.

id.description: Globally-unique kebab-case slug = brand + model, no mount. e.g. 'sigma-24-70mm-f28-dg-dn-art'.

model.description: Full marketing name including aperture and series, e.g. 'FE 24-70mm F2.8 GM II'.

series.description: Product line / grade, e.g. GM, G, RF L, S-Line, Art, Sport, Contemporary, PRO, S, S-Pro, Batis, XF, GF.

mounts.description: Every mount this exact optical design ships in. L-Mount covers the whole Leica/Panasonic/Sigma alliance (Leica SL/TL bodies included); it is a single physical mount, so Leica-native L lenses use 'L-Mount' too.

format.description: Image circle the lens is designed to cover.

apertureMaxWide.description: Widest aperture (smallest f-number) at the wide end, e.g. 2.8.

apertureMaxTele.description: Widest aperture at tele end; equals wide for constant-aperture zooms and primes.

filterThread.description: Front filter thread in mm; null if rear/none/bulb.

maxMagnification.description: Max reproduction ratio as a decimal, e.g. 0.5 for 1:2.

priceUSD.description: Current US street price (or MSRP if no street price) in USD.

dxomarkScore.description: DXOMark overall lens score if known (body-dependent; treat as indicative only).
